newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran to buy 5.5 mln tonnes Australia, Canada wheat.
newsitem.headline: Iran to buy 5.5 mln tonnes Australia, Canada wheat.

text.p: Iran expects to import three million tonnes of wheat from Australia and 2.5 million tonnes from Canada in the year to March 1998, an Iranian official said in remarks published on Tuesday.

"Iran will import 2.5 million tonnes of wheat in the current year from Canada which stands in this respect after Australia which will export three million tonnes of wheat to Iran," said Mir Mohammad Sadeqi, deputy head of the Iran-Canada Chamber of Commerce, in remarks quoted by the Tehran daily Abrar.
Sadeqi was referring to the Iranian year which ends on March 20, 1998.
Iran said in April it would import five million tonnes in the year.
An official said last month imports had increased due to a fall of a million tonnes in domestic production in the last crop year because of bad weather and lower cultivated acreage.
Western reports have said Iran's wheat imports were expected to reach 6.6 million tonnes in the year ending last month, making it the world's biggest importer.
